pr_body:
We should use the returned value when reading BytesRef from a BytesRefBlock. However, we didn't follow this pattern when reading IP values in enrich. 

Labeled as a non-issue for a non-released bug we just introduced in #106186.

Relates #106186

Fixes #106430

issue_context.title: [CI] EsqlClientYamlIT test {p0=esql/61_enrich_ip/IP} failing
issue_context.body:
Almost certainly related to the recent merge of https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/106186. The error message:
`Cannot decode IP field from bytes of length 0` seems to indicate that no bytes were read from the `BytesRefBlock`, which should not happen.
